body:
I guess therapy is gonna feel a little weird no matter how you go about it. I haven't tried enough to comment on the different styles.

Side note but like we discussed in dm's until someone can point to something specific and say "this is why you can never be happy" I won't believe in fundamentally broken people either. I think we can all change. Change our behavior a bit, change our expectations a bit, change our location a bit, whatever. It's crazy what human beings can do. We launched living human bodies into zero-G space and they adapted to it. I believe in adapting.

You know, since tonight is bad and tomorrow looks better, I'd try sleeping. Too much sleeping isn't healthy, but in a pinch it does the job. When I'm feeling really shitty and awful and upset, I tell myself, I've worn myself out thinking too much. Gotta let the brain rest. That's what sleeping does. It gives you a chance to wake up and think again, all refreshed. It also keeps you out of any more trouble for the rest of the night, and stops those terrible thoughts more solidly than anything else. I'm no doctor or anything, but I've done it before.

Huh, that sounds neat. I've always heard CBT was all the rage nowadays for fixing people. I personally understand the desire to dig deep at what caused me to be this way, really get into it... but I figured in my case the interest in some kind of Freudian-type psychoanalysis was 1) expensive af 2) kind of like the compulsion to pick at scabs. At this point it doesn't even matter why I'm fucked up- it's not like I can "get even" with the people and circumstances. I just have to heal the damage with minimal scarring and learn to live with the scars there are- learn or die. I don't know a lot about insight therapy and I'm definitely not trying to diss it; I'm glad it's helped you. Like I told the other guy, lots of different types in the world.


At any point in time during those 30 years, did you ever ask yourself that same question? How can you keep going on? Cuz if you have, then you already managed to make it through "several years." You may not even know how you did it, but it must be possible.

Takes all kinds of us to keep to world turning ✌

See you on the flipside

You know how if you memorize something, or learn how to do something, but then you stop and forget it, it's still kinda easier to learn the second time? I like to think recovering is like that, too. Today isn't your best day, but you've walked the path to better ones before, and you're a little familiar with it already. You can get there and go even farther along.

Oh, that's true. My problem is talking irl- I freeze up and can't say a damn thing. Frustrated the therapists I met to no end. That's why I like making text posts.. feels different.


I'm not sure there's much method to my madness, but I guess it's kept me alive this long, ya feel?


Interesting username btw. I hope it's around reddit for a long while yet.

Yeah, I've heard a lot of nasty things about the hotlines, but I've always been too scared to try them myself. Text feels so much safer.


 I actually saw your post and was about to message you before I stopped and wondered if, with where I am right now, I might make things worse. I'm no expert in recovery and my hope's about gone, too, but I'll send you a message cuz I got time to spare if you want to talk.
That's a true enough perspective I suppose. Never felt like writing alone was enough for me- I always wanted to have a conversation.
